INSERT INTO t_phase_one_feedback_list_projection_dirty( source_id,mutation_version,dirty_reason,task_status,retry_count,next_retry_at, lease_owner,lease_expires_at,last_error_code,last_error_summary ) VALUES
(#{sourceId},1,#{dirtyReason},'PENDING',0,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)
AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE mutation_version=t_phase_one_feedback_list_projection_dirty.mutation_version+1, dirty_reason=incoming.dirty_reason, task_status='PENDING',retry_count=0,next_retry_at=NULL, lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,last_error_code=NULL,last_error_summary=NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT source_id,mutation_version,dirty_reason,task_status,retry_count,next_retry_at, lease_owner,lease_expires_at,last_error_code,last_error_summary,created_at,updated_at FROM t_phase_one_feedback_list_projection_dirty WHERE ( (task_status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))) OR (task_status='PROCESSING' AND lease_expires_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) )
AND source_id IN
#{sourceId}
ORDER BY source_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.delete:
DELETE FROM t_phase_one_feedback_list_projection_dirty WHERE lease_owner=#{leaseOwner} AND (source_id,mutation_version) IN
(#{row.sourceId},#{row.mutationVersion})
mapper.update:
UPDATE t_phase_one_feedback_list_projection_dirty SET task_status='PENDING',next_retry_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{delaySeconds},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL WHERE lease_owner=#{leaseOwner} AND (source_id,mutation_version) IN
(#{row.sourceId},#{row.mutationVersion})

UPDATE t_phase_one_feedback_list_projection_dirty SET task_status='RETRY',retry_count=retry_count+1, next_retry_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{delaySeconds},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,last_error_code=#{errorCode},last_error_summary=#{errorSummary} WHERE lease_owner=#{leaseOwner} AND (source_id,mutation_version) IN
(#{row.sourceId},#{row.mutationVersion})

UPDATE t_phase_one_feedback_list_projection_dirty SET task_status='FAILED',retry_count=retry_count+1,next_retry_at=NULL, lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,last_error_code=#{errorCode},last_error_summary=#{errorSummary} WHERE lease_owner=#{leaseOwner} AND (source_id,mutation_version) IN
(#{row.sourceId},#{row.mutationVersion})
